instructions.olderFossil: After defeating Ghetsis, a Worker in Twist Mountain gives one older fossil daily. Revive the fossil for this species at the Nacrene City Museum.
instructions.tirtouga: Choose the Cover Fossil in Relic Castle and revive it at the Nacrene City Museum for a level 25 Tirtouga. This local choice excludes the Plume Fossil.
instructions.archen: Choose the Plume Fossil in Relic Castle and revive it at the Nacrene City Museum for a level 25 Archen. This local choice excludes the Cover Fossil.
instructions.zorua: Bring a valid event Celebi to the Game Freak building in Castelia City and speak to the character hiding Zorua. The Black/White event needs that special Celebi, not an ordinary one.
instructions.zoroark: The special Lostlorn Forest encounter requires a compatible event Shiny Raikou, Entei or Suicune transferred via the Relocator. You can also evolve Zorua at level 30.
instructions.larvesta: A Ranger in the house on Route 18 gives a Larvesta Egg. Leave a free party slot and use Surf to reach the island.
instructions.volcarona: After completing the story, explore deep inside Relic Castle to encounter a level 70 Volcarona. Alternatively, evolve Larvesta at level 59.
instructions.darmanitan: Use a Rage Candy Bar on a Darmanitan statue in Desert Resort to start a level 35 encounter. This specimen has Zen Mode; normal Darumaka evolution is another route.
instructions.musharna: A special level 50 Musharna appears on Fridays in the Dreamyard basement. You can also use a Moon Stone on Munna.
instructions.victini: You need the event Liberty Pass. Take the boat at the westernmost Castelia City pier to Liberty Garden to encounter Victini.
instructions.cobalion: Cobalion is level 42 in Mistralton Cave’s Guidance Chamber. Battling it unlocks the Terrakion and Virizion encounters.
instructions.terrakion: First battle Cobalion in Mistralton Cave. Then access the level 42 Terrakion in Victory Road’s Trial Chamber.
instructions.virizion: First battle Cobalion in Mistralton Cave. Then find the level 42 Virizion in Pinwheel Forest’s Rumination Field.
instructions.tornadus: After the eighth badge, speak to the receptionist at the Route 10 gate. Visit the Route 7 house during the storm and listen to the woman. On leaving, Tornadus starts roaming Unova at level 40; gate bulletin boards help locate the storm.
instructions.landorus: Bring Tornadus and Thundurus together in your party to Abundant Shrine. In Black, Thundurus must come from another compatible game: it is not this version’s roaming Pokémon.
